paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 4, halakhah 4, saying: “A person must fix a place for himself in the synagogue,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:4 paragraph fully names Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanina and gives the quoted requirement to designate a place in the synagogue. Only the supplied quotation is translated; the other figures and legal discussion are not imported or linked to authorities.
